notice: 5 matched walking-height viewpoints in each of four conditions, captured from the recorded production game source. Open any picture at its original size.
setup: Production app, scene, actors, lighting and renderer at High quality, 1280 × 800. Automatic animation was paused and explicit frames rendered at fixed on-foot cameras 1.65 m above their supporting surfaces. Local simulation dates and weather were controlled; capturedAt records the real capture time.
limitations: Fixed on-foot appearance fixtures; cameras were positioned for inspection. These pictures do not establish a traversed route, activity completion, physical-phone behavior or hardware FPS.

The Loupe picture is taken on its modeled supporting floor, not a drone. It does not establish a completed elevator ride or an accurate distant Seattle skyline. Snow particles currently appear inside the modeled Glasshouse; indoor weather occlusion needs work. The captured High-quality submitted workload reaches 1,532,282 triangles / 473 draw calls; full-scene performance remains open.
